ينتخبون (form VIII)
# يَنْتَخِبُونَ (yantaḵibūna) /jan.ta.xi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
# يُنْتَخَبُونَ (yuntaḵabūna) /jun.ta.xa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَخَبَ (intaḵaba)
